bp1.detailed_description: Designed and built from scratch a comprehensive Python-based production data migration tool to address critical business needs for a major project launch with a 3-week deadline. Previously, data migration between DEV/STAGE/PROD environments required 2+ hours of manual work from multiple engineers, involving complex technical data validation and movement across 8 different database tables with intricate foreign key relationships. The tool I built automated this entire process, featuring comprehensive logging, API-based architecture for customization, and various features requested by senior and lead engineers. The system handles complex relational data structures, maintains referential integrity across environments, and became integral to the full website building process through multiple iterations. Built with robust error handling, rollback capabilities, and detailed audit trails to ensure zero-error deployments.

bp2.project_name: Legacy Java to Cloud Python Migration
bp2.detailed_description: Led the complete migration of a legacy Java application to a modern Python-based cloud architecture to resolve critical performance issues. The original Java application suffered from consistent high database locks that worsened as the user base grew, creating bottlenecks that the old infrastructure couldn't handle. Redesigned the entire system using Python with AWS Lambda for serverless processing, SQS for reliable message queuing, and DynamoDB for high-performance NoSQL storage. The cloud-native rewrite eliminated database lock contention, provided automatic scaling capabilities, and dramatically improved system stability and versatility. The new architecture can handle sudden traffic spikes and scales automatically based on demand.
challenges_solved: High database lock contention in legacy Java application
Performance degradation with growing user base
Complex deployment process with downtime requirements

business_impact.cost_optimization: 40% reduction in infrastructure costs through serverless
business_impact.user_experience: Eliminated timeout errors and slow responses

technical_achievements: Designed event-driven serverless architecture for automatic scaling
Implemented SQS dead letter queues for reliable message processing
Created DynamoDB data model optimized for high-throughput operations
Built comprehensive CloudWatch monitoring and alerting
Established Infrastructure as Code for repeatable deployments
Implemented circuit breaker pattern for fault tolerance

bp3.detailed_description: Architected and implemented comprehensive disaster recovery strategies for T. Rowe Price's critical financial infrastructure in AWS US-East-2 region. The project involved establishing automated failover mechanisms, cross-region data replication, backup automation, and recovery procedures for mission-critical financial services. Implemented Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and CloudFormation for consistent DR environment provisioning. Created automated backup systems with point-in-time recovery capabilities, established RTO (Recovery Time Objective) of 2 hours and RPO (Recovery Point Objective) of 30 minutes. Built comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to ensure high availability and rapid response to infrastructure issues. Designed automated failover mechanisms using Route53 health checks and ELB for seamless traffic routing during disaster scenarios.

Cross-region RDS read replicas with promotion capabilities
S3 cross-region replication for data backup
Automated infrastructure provisioning in DR region
Application load balancer health checks and traffic routing
Automated notification systems for disaster events
